buscar: Search by MAC, account or door

vacio.texto: Boards show up on their own once they are powered on and connected to the network cable.

vincularTitulo: Link the board to a door
vincularTexto: Board {{mac}} will be assigned to the account and door you choose once you confirm with its button.
puertaPlaceholder: Choose a door without a reader
sinPuertasLibres: This account has no doors without a reader.
liberarTexto: The door is left without a reader and the board stops opening it. You can then link it to another account.
bajaTexto: It leaves the inventory. Use this if the board was lost or damaged.
confirmarTexto: Board {{mac}} is waiting for someone to confirm it is at the right door.
confirmarPaso1: Go to the door where the board is installed.
confirmarPaso2: Hold the exit button for 5 seconds, until the LED blinks and a beep sounds.
confirmarPaso3: The board links itself; this panel will show it in a few seconds.
confirmarVentana_one: You have {{count}} minute to press the button. If it runs out, link the board again.
confirmarVentana_other: You have {{count}} minutes to press the button. If it runs out, link the board again.
vincularAPuertaTexto: Pick one of the detected boards. It will be assigned to this door once you confirm with its button.
sinPlacasDetectadas: No boards detected. Plug them into the network cable and wait a few seconds.
sensorDe: Configure the sensor of the board {{mac}}
sensorTexto: The sensor tells whether the door was left open after a pulse. Without a sensor, the result of each opening stays unconfirmed.
sensorNivel: Sensor level with the door open
sensorPolaridad: The polarity is confirmed in the field: with the door open, check that the chosen level is the one reaching the board before saving.
ubicacionAyuda: If the door has a reader outside and another inside, link one board for each. With a single board, leave it on “A single board”.
